source.name: Z-Anatomy Models of human anatomy
source.attribution: BodyParts3D, Z-Anatomy, and upstream contributors recorded by the source revision

modifications: Mapped source object names to stable semantic heart targets.
Corrected the source hierarchy of the posterior mitral leaflet.
Derived anterior mitral and tricuspid leaflet geometry from source leaflets for this development build.
Authored a synchronized 0.8-second cardiac cycle at 75 beats per minute.
Added atrial and ventricular deformation morphs with longitudinal shortening and ventricular twist.
Added hinge-articulated atrioventricular and semilunar valve morphs with non-overlapping isovolumetric closure windows.
Added six directional circulation paths with oxygenation-state metadata, Y-up centerlines, and arrowheads.
Removed unrelated peripheral vessel descendants and exported without Draco compression.
known_simplifications: This is a research-aligned educational visualization, not a biomechanical or fluid simulation.
The source lacked one visible mitral leaflet and one visible tricuspid leaflet; derived replacements are disclosed in GLB extras.
Ventricular wall thickening and twist are procedural approximations rather than measurements fitted to imaging from a specific subject.
Flow curves encode anatomical order and oxygenation state; moving blood particles are implemented by the Phase 3 runtime.
Flow colors are educational conventions and do not represent literal blood color.
